cases.name: unknown argument is a usage error
the full report names the registrations, the graph and the git hook
a README beside the tools is documentation, never an executable missing +x
cases.cmd: bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep -q 'executable README' && echo flagged || echo clean

cases.name: a root where the plugin is not enabled is a FAIL, not a crash
a kit.config.json naming an unknown preset is a FAIL with the presets available
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/lib
cp {{KIT}}/lib/kit_config.py {{KIT}}/lib/kit_testtag.py $R/.claude/lib/ && cp -R {{KIT}}/presets $R/.claude/
printf '%s' '{"preset": "onion"}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet

expect.stdout: unknown preset 'onion' — available: clean-architecture, hexagonal, vertical-slices

cases.name: a root without rules nor config is told to run kit-init
the plugin enabled in the committed settings is ok
an outdated markdown-output.md, without the kit anchors, is flagged
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules
printf 'Run `python3 .claude/scripts/rules-coverage.py`.\n' > $R/CLAUDE.md
printf 'Old literals, parsed by `.claude/hooks/implement-tdd-guard.sh`.\n' > $R/.claude/rules/markdown-output.md
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -E 'rules outdated' | sed -E 's/^WARN +//; s/ {2,}.*//; s/ (\.claude|CLAUDE).*//' | tr '\n' ';'

cases.name: tooling lines over the opt-in budget print a NOTE, never a FAIL
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules
printf 'a\nb\nc\n' > $R/.claude/rules/x.md
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor --quiet | grep -E '^(NOTE tooling budget|FAIL tooling)' | cut -c1-20

cases.name: without the budget variable the doctor prints no tooling budget line
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules
printf 'a\nb\nc\n' > $R/.claude/rules/x.md
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep -c 'tooling budget'

cases.name: bytecode under __pycache__ is not counted as tooling lines
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/rules $R/.claude/lib/__pycache__
printf 'a\nb\nc\n' > $R/.claude/rules/x.md
seq 50 > $R/.claude/lib/__pycache__/y.cpython-314.pyc
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep 'tooling budget' | tr -s ' '

cases.name: a git-ignored settings.json enabling the plugin warns that worktrees miss it
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude
git init -q $R
printf '.claude/\n' > $R/.gitignore
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep -E 'post-checkout|worktree plugin'
rm -rf $R

cases.name: a committable settings.json enabling the plugin needs no post-checkout hook
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/doc-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude
git init -q $R
printf '%s' '{"enabledPlugins":{"cctoolkit@cctoolkit":true}}' > $R/.claude/settings.json
bash {{KIT}}/tools/doctor | grep -E 'post-checkout|worktree plugin'
rm -rf $R
